newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 18.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Wednesday ended higher in line with firmer cargo prices, traders said. Bunker 380-cst was quoted between $117 to $120 per tonne while 180-cst was at $123-$125. Prices firmed after cargoes rose with crude. MDO was steady at $205-$210 and gas oil at around $220-$225.-- Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
